name: Namecheap
description: Namecheap is a domain name registrar that also sells hosting and related services.
useCases: Registering a domain for a site
limitations: Domain prices vary by extension; check renewal prices before buying
Renewal prices are higher than the first-year sale prices; check the renewal price before buying

plans.name: .com domain
plans.note: Register $11.28 (sale: 25% off the first year, regular $14.98); renew $18.48; transfer $11.48

pricing.regional: Prices were shown in USD. Namecheap says ICANN charges a mandatory annual fee of $0.20 per domain, added to some listed prices at purchase. Hosting, email and other products were not read.
notes: The page showed promotional banners (for example .com at $6.48 for new customers) that differ from the table figure, so first-year prices depend on the offer at checkout; renewal prices are higher than the sale prices.
The page lists free privacy protection for life, free DNSSEC and a 1-month free email trial with registration.
